name: Hassan Zaheer
headline: Managing Partner @ PTR | Advisory Board @CWIEME, APC Media & STS Capital | Virtual Advisory Board Network
summary:
I work at the intersection of electrical infrastructure and energy transition, helping my clients as a  strategic growth partner.

I’m the Managing Partner & COO at Power Technology Research (PTR), where I lead global operations, sales, and marketing, supporting electrical equipment manufacturers, utilities, and investors with market intelligence, GTM strategy, commercial due diligence, and growth advisory, primarily across North America and EMEA.

Alongside PTR, I hold advisory and board-level roles across industry platforms contributing towards shaping the future of the sector. I serve on advisory boards for CWIEME Berlin, World Utilities Congress (Technical Committee Advisor & Session Chair), and the MENA EV Show, and sit on the Executive Editorial Board at APC Media, guiding content strategy for Transformer Technology, Power Systems Technology, and Women in Power Systems. I am also a Deal Advisor and Certified Exit Guide with STS Capital Partners, supporting founder-led businesses in preparing for strategic exits.

My focus is on bridging strategy with commercial execution, insights with real world impact, and technology with market reality, especially across the rapidly evolving power grid space.

Always open to thoughtful conversations with operators, founders, and leaders shaping the future of power, utilities, and energy infrastructure.

company.name: PTR
company.tagline: Empowering Proactive Decision-Making in the Global Energy Sector with Strategic Insights
company.description:
PTR provides specialized market research about Power Grid and New Energy equipment through bespoke or syndicated research for our clients among Fortune-500, FTSE-100, DAX-30, NIKKEI-225 companies.

Founded by market research professionals with nearly 30 years of combined experience in global market research firms. The company was built on three pillars of excellence: 
Transparency,
Diligence, and
Digestibility.

We take huge pride in what we do for our clients as we aim to surpass ambiguous methodology and uninspired presentation, which has led most market research to remain relegated to ‘me-too’ slides, often remaining a footnote in presentations. Our goal is to change that, and bring back pro-active decision making within the global power and e-mobility sectors. 

Our market analysis is presented through PTR's data visualization platform, utilizing Microsoft Power BI. This consists of an interactive report to best extract key trends and data while also providing multiple dashboards to better understand the methodology and to keep updated on the latest trends in each segment throughout the one-year subscription. Think of it as a one-stop shop to stay up to date on the latest trends. 

With a differentiated approach to market research, Power Technology Research can assist you in identifying, valuing, and bench-marking opportunities in a multitude of topics within these industries.

Please contact us at sales@ptr.inc
